targetCohort: Indian skincare beginners and routine-switchers, roughly 18–40, who can see acne, oiliness, marks, or texture but do not know what deserves attention first.
awarenessStage: Problem aware; uncertain whether a scan is useful, private, or appropriate for their concern.
readerTakeaway: A 60-second MyMirror scan can organize visible signals into a calmer starting point; it is not a diagnosis or a replacement for a dermatologist.
objections: I do not want a beauty score or a judgement about my face.
I am unsure what happens to my photo and whether I need an account.
I do not want another generic routine or an AI answer that sounds medical.
I need to know when I should skip a scan and speak to a dermatologist instead.
ctaConnection: The CTA is earned after the page shows what the scan can organize, its limits, and the practical next step the reader will receive.

judgmentChecks.notes: Audience and CTA fit the approved MyMirror position and avoid a diagnosis promise.
